origin: User-approved line-art crop of Alice's original illustration; no external character pixels used.

commands.monochrome: magick assets/alice-line.png -fuzz 20% -transparent white -channel RGB -fill white -colorize 100 +channel assets/alice-mono.png
commands.application: cp assets/alice-line.png assets/alice-icon.png; cp assets/alice-mono.png assets/alice-symbolic.png

usage: Transparent desktop application icon and Omarchy tray launcher. The bar uses the dedicated color head-and-headdress crop with 16px of extra icon slot space and 32 more for the usage label; the popup keeps the full color illustration. The monochrome files remain asset explorations but are not loaded by the tray.
review: Pixel and monochrome alternatives were reviewed and are not shipped in the minimal Omarchy menu.
